description: Deploy HTML/CSS websites to ERPNext/Frappe (v15/v16) as Web Pages via the REST API. Use this skill whenever a user wants to host a website on ERPNext, deploy HTML mockups to Frappe, create Web Pages programmatically, configure Website Settings, or integrate Frappe's Discussion system as a forum. Also use when the user mentions "website on ERPNext", "Web Page API", "Page Builder", "Web Template", or wants to serve custom HTML from Frappe. Covers: Web Pages with Page Builder, custom Web Templates, Website Settings (navbar, footer), CSS management, Frappe Discussion integration, and deployment scripting.
